title: Record Hint Triage Queue
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:record hint_status=*
| stats count as hints by hint_status repository
| sort - hints
description: Summarizes open, dismissed, and accepted record hints so you can keep the research queue under control.
value: Hints are useful only when triaged; otherwise they become noise that obscures the truly promising leads.
implementation: Ingest hint status from genealogy platforms and summarize counts by repository and state.
visualization: Table of record hints by repository and status.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how many record hints are still waiting for you to review instead of piling up unseen.
